title: Molecular Mechanism of the Intercalation of the SOX-4 Protein into DNA Inducing Bends and Kinks.
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过长时间元动力学和分子动力学模拟，揭示了转录因子SOX4嵌入DNA诱导弯曲和扭结的分子机制，精准聚焦TF-DNA互作动态机理，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: DNA-protein interactions regulate several biophysical functions, yet the mechanism of only a few is investigated in molecular detail. An important example is the intercalation of transcription factor proteins into DNA that produce bent and kinked DNA. Here, we have studied the molecular mechanism of the intercalation of a transcription factor SOX4 into DNA with a goal to understand the sequence of molecular events that precede the bending and kinking of the DNA. Our long well-tempered metadynamics and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations show that the protein primarily binds to the backbone of DNA and rotates around it to form an intercalative native state. We show that although there are multiple pathways for intercalation, the deintercalation pathway matches with the most probable intercalation pathway. In both cases, bending and kinking happen simultaneously, driven by the onset of the intercalation of the amino acid.
abstract_zh: DNA-蛋白质相互作用调控多种生物物理功能，然而仅有少数机制在分子细节上得到研究。一个重要的例子是转录因子蛋白质插入DNA中，产生弯曲和扭结的DNA。在此，我们研究了转录因子SOX4插入DNA的分子机制，旨在理解DNA弯曲和扭结之前发生的分子事件序列。我们的长时间良态元动力学和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟表明，蛋白质主要结合到DNA骨架并围绕其旋转，形成插入性天然状态。我们显示，尽管存在多种插入途径，去插入途径与最可能的插入途径相匹配。在两种情况下，弯曲和扭结同时发生，由氨基酸插入的起始驱动。
